Semantic architecture

GUI2TUI turns accessibility semantics into terminal-native tasks and readable content.

The reader deliberately reflows paragraphs instead of copying graphical coordinates.

Progressive materialization

  • Load the visible semantic viewport.
  • Keep a small look-ahead window.
  • Invalidate only content changed by accessibility events.
Graphical layout is not the semantic contract.
